credits_spent: one build on the free plan
failures: N2: The donation form accepts an amount, name and email and offers a 'Pledge €50.00' button, but nothing is stored: the admin page reports 0 pledges and €0.00, and no reference number is shown to the donor.
N3: The volunteer form behaves the same way — filled in, submitted, no confirmation, and 0 sign-ups in the admin view.
N6 note: the admin page works (it renders the tables), which makes the empty result visible rather than silent. That is how the failure was proven.

artifacts.label: Admin after two submissions: zero pledges, zero sign-ups

notes: Bolt built seven pages in one prompt, but uses hash routing: every page lives at /#/donate, /#/volunteer and so on, so the server returns the same document for any path. Navigation works in a browser; a shared link to /donate does not. The preview also showed a Tailwind build error ('@tailwind base' directive) that did not stop publishing. The decisive failure is data: both forms accept input and write nothing, which the admin view proves by staying at zero.
